* dec_R75SW What formats should audit logs and run transcripts use?    :audit-tx:
:PROPERTIES:
:ID:            dec_R75SW
:GLOSSARY_REFS: term_YC32J term_KCGEH term_N5SJT
:DECIDED_AT:    [2026-05-21 Thu 19:06]
:SOURCE:        archive/21_05_26_init/spec.org::*Tx files (.org, property-drawer-only)
:END:
** Context
Workers, managers, and daemon actions need inspectable durable evidence. A database event log gives strong querying but weaker Git-native inspection and migration burden; EDN payloads in Org add structure but violate the no-escape-hatch file profile.
** Decision
Tx files are property-drawer-only Org and sessions are append-only JSONL. Audit logs stay grep-friendly while run transcripts stay tail-and-jq-friendly. No EDN, and no automatic session compression in v0.0.1.
** Consequences
The audit and transcript surfaces stay Git-native and inspectable without an external database.
